ED_Title: Election of members of the Economic and Social Council
ED_DecisionText:
At its 87th plenary meeting, on 4 June 2026, the General Assembly, in accordance with rule 140 of the rules of procedure of the Assembly, elected Luxembourg as a member of the Economic and Social Council for the remainder of the term of office of Switzerland  (footnote: A/80/738) beginning on 1 January 2027 and ending on 31 December 2027. 

At the same meeting, the General Assembly, in accordance with Article 61 of the Charter of the United Nations, rule 145 of the rules of procedure of the Assembly and paragraph 17 of Assembly resolution 68/307 of 10 September 2014, elected Angola, Bolivia (Plurinational State of), Brazil, Eritrea, France, Germany, Guatemala, Guinea, Ireland, Malaysia, Maldives, Morocco, North Macedonia, Portugal, the Republic of Korea, Senegal and the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland as members of the Economic and Social Council for a three-year term of office beginning on 1 January 2027 to fill the vacancies occurring on the expiration of the terms of office of Austria, France, Germany, Haiti, Japan, Kenya, Mauritania, Nepal, Nigeria, Pakistan, Paraguay, Poland, Senegal, Spain, Suriname, the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland, Uruguay and Zambia. 

At its 93rd plenary meeting, on 25 June 2026, the General Assembly, in accordance with Article 61 of the Charter of the United Nations, rule 145 of the rules of procedure of the Assembly and paragraph 17 of Assembly resolution 68/307 of 10 September 2014, elected the Bahamas as a member of the Economic and Social Council for a three-year term of office beginning on 1 January 2027. 

As a result, as of 1 January 2027, the Economic and Social Council is composed of the following Member States: Algeria,* Angola,*** Antigua and Barbuda,* Armenia, * Australia,** Azerbaijan,* Bahamas,*** Bangladesh,* Bolivia (Plurinational State of), *** Brazil,*** Burundi,** Canada,* Chad,** China,** Côte d’Ivoire,* Croatia,** Djibouti,* Dominican Republic,* Ecuador,** Eritrea,*** Finland,** France,*** Germany,*** Guatemala,*** Guinea,*** India,** Ireland,*** Lebanon,** Luxembourg,*** Malaysia,*** Maldives,*** Mexico,* Morocco,*** Mozambique,** Netherlands (Kingdom of the),* North Macedonia,*** Norway,** Peru,** Portugal,*** Republic of Korea,*** Russian Federation,** Saint Kitts and Nevis,** Saudi Arabia,* Senegal,*** Sierra Leone,** South Africa,* Sri Lanka,* Türkiye,** Turkmenistan,** Ukraine,** United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland,*** United Republic of Tanzania,* United States of America* and Uzbekistan*.

* Term of office expires on 31 December 2027. 
** Term of office expires on 31 December 2028. 
*** Term of office expires on 31 December 2029.
